question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Aggregate total quantities per top-level container per leaf item
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS total_qty_so_far
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (531, 532, 533, 534)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.total_qty_so_far * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
)
SELECT 
    p_top.name AS top_container,
    p_leaf.name AS leaf_item,
    SUM(h.total_qty_so_far) AS total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p_top ON p_top.id = h.top_id
JOIN packaging p_leaf ON p_leaf.id = h.current_id
WHERE h.current_id IN (501, 502)
GROUP BY p_top.name, p_leaf.name
HAVING SUM(h.total_qty_so_far) > 500
ORDER BY p_top.name, p_leaf.name
